title: Flutter Buttons
subtitle: Master ElevatedButton, TextButton, OutlinedButton, IconButton, and FloatingActionButton with custom styles and states.

properties.name: onPressed
properties.description: Callback function triggered when the user taps the button. Set to null to disable the button.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The primary content displayed inside the button (usually a Text or Icon widget).

properties.name: style
properties.description: Applies visual styles including background color, foreground color, padding, elevation, and shape.
